segments.text: Day three of 100 Days of Machine Learning: the machine learning workflow.
segments.caption: Day 3 of 100 Days of Machine Learning: the machine learning workflow.

segments.text: The seven steps every real project follows, one example from start to finish, and the mistake most beginners make. Save this one!
segments.caption: The 7 steps every real project follows, one example from start to finish, and the mistake most beginners make. Save this one!

segments.text: Everyone thinks machine learning is about choosing the perfect algorithm.
segments.caption: Everyone thinks machine learning is about choosing the perfect algorithm.

segments.text: In real jobs, training the model is maybe ten percent of the work. The other ninety percent? Everything around it.
segments.caption: In real jobs, training the model is maybe 10% of the work. The other 90%? Everything around it.

segments.text: Let's build one project, step by step: predicting flat prices in Pune.
segments.caption: Let's build one project, step by step: predicting flat prices in Pune.

segments.text: Step one: define the problem.
segments.caption: Step 1: define the problem.

segments.text: What exactly do we predict? The price of a flat, in lakhs. That's a number, so it's a regression problem.
segments.caption: What exactly do we predict? The price of a flat, in lakhs. That's a number, so it's a regression problem.

segments.text: And how will we judge success? Say, our predictions should be within five lakh on average.
segments.caption: And how will we judge success? Say, our predictions should be within 5 lakh on average.

segments.text: Step two: collect data.
segments.caption: Step 2: collect data.

segments.text: We gather past sales: area, bedrooms, location, age of the building, and the price each flat actually sold for. Say, ten thousand flats.
segments.caption: We gather past sales: area, bedrooms, location, age of the building, and the price each flat actually sold for. Say, 10,000 flats.

segments.text: Step three, the biggest one: clean the data.
segments.caption: Step 3, the biggest one: clean the data.

segments.text: Real data is messy. Some rows have missing prices. Some flats are listed twice. Someone typed the area as twelve thousand instead of twelve hundred.
segments.caption: Real data is messy. Some rows have missing prices. Some flats are listed twice. Someone typed the area as 12,000 instead of 1,200.

segments.text: We fill or remove the gaps, delete duplicates and fix the typos. Garbage in, garbage out.
segments.caption: We fill or remove the gaps, delete duplicates and fix the typos. Garbage in, garbage out.

segments.text: Step four: explore the data.
segments.caption: Step 4: explore the data.

segments.text: We plot it and look for patterns. Bigger flats cost more. Flats near the IT parks cost more. Older buildings cost a little less.
segments.caption: We plot it and look for patterns. Bigger flats cost more. Flats near the IT parks cost more. Older buildings cost a little less.

segments.text: Step five, the one beginners skip: split the data.
segments.caption: Step 5, the one beginners skip: split the data.

segments.text: We hide twenty percent of the flats away. The model learns from the other eighty percent only.
segments.caption: We hide 20% of the flats away. The model learns from the other 80% only.

segments.text: Why? It's like an exam. If you've already seen the question paper, a high score proves nothing.
segments.caption: Why? It's like an exam. If you've already seen the question paper, a high score proves nothing.

segments.text: Step six: train the model.
segments.caption: Step 6: train the model.

segments.text: On the eight thousand training flats, the model guesses, measures its error, and adjusts, again and again, exactly like we saw on day one.
segments.caption: On the 8,000 training flats, the model guesses, measures its error, and adjusts, again and again, exactly like we saw on Day 1.

segments.text: Step seven: evaluate, then deploy.
segments.caption: Step 7: evaluate, then deploy.

segments.text: Now the exam: the two thousand hidden flats. The model's predictions are off by four lakh on average. Our target was five. Passed!
segments.caption: Now the exam: the 2,000 hidden flats. The model's predictions are off by 4 lakh on average. Our target was 5. Passed!

segments.text: So we put it in an app, and keep watching it. Prices change, so the model is retrained every few months.
segments.caption: So we put it in an app, and keep watching it. Prices change, so the model is retrained every few months.

segments.text: So remember the seven steps: define, collect, clean, explore, split, train, evaluate and deploy.
segments.caption: So remember the 7 steps: define, collect, clean, explore, split, train, evaluate and deploy.

segments.text: Save this. It's the map for the next ninety-seven days.
segments.caption: Save this. It's the map for the next 97 days.
